title: Heated Pool + Spa + Fire Pit + Hammock Swings
description:
Stylish, Comfortable, Brand New

Decorated with comfort & luxury in mind. Your stay is hosted by a top 1% host, as designated by AirBNB, and she thought of everything!

A backyard resort awaits you - heated pool, spa, firepit, swings, lounge chairs, dining table, grill, games. We supply pool towels and floats.

NEW: We are equipped with 3 Tesla PowerWalls and solar panels for uninterrupted power.

Pool Heat Fee: $35 per night (our cost)
Request one day before check-in

 Other things to note 
Please note the safety features that are available to you if you have children. We have alarms on both sliding glass doors that you can turn on. We also have locks at the tops of both sliding glass doors.

After booking, keep an eye on your email for action items related to City of Tempe requirements.
